name: JW Marriott Guanacaste Resort & Spa
insider_take: This luxury resort sits on one of Costa Rica's most pristine coastlines, where the dry tropical forest meets the Pacific Ocean in perfect harmony.
whats_special: The resort is built within the 2,300-acre Peninsula Papagayo, a protected nature reserve that's home to over 150 bird species and countless wildlife. The property features Costa Rica's only Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course and sits along Playa Mansita, one of the country's most secluded beaches with calm waters perfect for swimming year-round.
pro_tip: Visit during the dry season (December-April) when you'll witness spectacular sunsets and have the best chance of spotting howler monkeys, iguanas, and exotic birds right from your terrace.
dont_miss: The resort's signature spa treatment using volcanic mud and local coffee scrubs, plus early morning nature walks where guests regularly spot sloths, coatis, and over 20 butterfly species. The Peninsula Papagayo's unique microclimate means less rainfall than other Costa Rican destinations, making it ideal for outdoor adventures.
pros: Stunning Peninsula Papagayo location with pristine beaches
World-class spa facilities and wellness treatments
Premium JW Marriott luxury service and amenities
Exceptional dining venues with ocean views
cons: Remote location requiring longer travel time
